SELECT PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECNAME, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECFULLNAME, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECCODE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.MARKET, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INSTITUTION, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUEPRICE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUBENDDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.VDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.MDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUEAMT, CUSTOMER_INFO1.CUSTOMER_NAME issuerName, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECTYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECTYPE2, CASE PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUETYPE WHEN '01' THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS ISSUETYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.BLNAREA, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUS, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSECBOND, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CITY_INVEST_SEC_CHB CITYINVESTSECWIND, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CCY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.FACEVALUE, CUSTOMER_INFO2.CUSTOMER_NAME WARRANTOR, PAYHSRCSECINFO.GUARTYPE, CASE
WHEN ( PAYHSRCSECINFO.CALLOPTION = 'Y' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUTOPTION = 'Y' ) THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS IS_RIGHT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.REMARK, PAYHSRCSECINFO.COUPONSPECIES, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INTERESTRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PAPERIR, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SPREADRATE_8 SPREADRATE8, PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATECODE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.COEFFICIENT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.TOPRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.BOTTOMRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.RESETTYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.OBSERVEBEFDAY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.OBSERVEBEFUNIT, CASE
WHEN ( PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_COUP' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUTOPTION = 'A_B_DAY' ) THEN 'A/A' ELSE PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC END AS RATEBASIC, CASE
WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_COUP' THEN '02' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_DAY' THEN '01' END AS BASISSTYLE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.WORKDAYRULE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PAYCYCLE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SCHECALRULE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.FIRSTRATEDAY FROM INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO PAYHSRCSECINFO LEFT JOIN INTERF_CUSTOMER_INFO CUSTOMER_INFO1 ON PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUERSHORT = CUSTOMER_INFO1.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN INTERF_CUSTOMER_INFO CUSTOMER_INFO2 ON CUSTOMER_INFO1.CUSTOMER_ID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.GUARANTOR LEFT JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECOPTION PAYHSRCSECOPTION ON PAYHSRCSECOPTION.SECID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID LEFT JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECRATING PAYHSRCSECRATING ON PAYHSRCSECRATING.SECID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID AND PAYHSRCSECRATING.ratingtype = 'C' LEFT JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECRATING PAYHSRCSECRATING2 ON PAYHSRCSECRATING2.SECID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID AND PAYHSRCSECRATING2.ratingtype = 'I'
PAYHSRCSECINFO.VDATE <= STR_TO_DATE ( #{iplatformDate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
AND PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID = #{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
